App.ProviderVerification: Complete verification in 1Password if prompted. Then opssh will discover SSH keys.
Error.Busy: A request is already in progress. Try again after it completes.
Error.ConfigurationWrite: Could not save the public configuration.
Error.ControlRequestFailed: The core request could not complete.
Error.IndexUnreadable: The public key index could not be opened.
Error.InvalidConfiguration: The public configuration is invalid or unreadable.
Error.InvalidKey: The selected private key has an unsupported or invalid format.
Error.InvalidSettings: Check the account name, item IDs, cache duration and duplicate public keys.
Error.KeyMismatch: The private key no longer matches the public index. Refresh the item.
Error.Locked: Unlock opssh before loading a private key.
Error.PartialIndex: The public index is incomplete. Check 1Password desktop access and refresh.
Error.PipeUnavailable: The SSH agent pipe is unavailable or already in use.
Error.PublicLookup: The public key lookup failed. Check 1Password desktop integration and the selected item, then refresh.
Error.RequestFailed: The request could not be completed.
Error.RestartRequired: Restart the core to use the selected account.
Error.ScanLimit: Discovery can scan up to 256 vaults and 8,192 item overviews per scoped vault. The public index is empty.
Error.ScopeTooBroad: The scope selects more than 64 SSH keys. Narrow the selection and refresh the public index.
Error.UnknownKey: Select a key with a current public index.
